searchText: fellas, this is a small cleanup I proposed based on my discussions with <@301186049323958275> and others: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8316 <@543900561460822016> could you take a look and see if that PR makes sense? this is also confusing to me imo, just calling it gas, the value burned is blobbasefee * (#blobs * "gas" per blob) ive seen it called blobgas, but `blobbasefeeperblobgas` is verbose Verbose is good. if there is a less verbose way then no, if this is the least verbose way to get the idea across then yes Do you have a suggestion for a variable name that conveys a similar amount of information in less words? nope It is not the same as normal gas, so we can't just call it gas lest developers be confused. yeah agree And it is a "fee per gas", not a total fee, so we can't call it "fee" without specifying units, lest developers be confused. I agree with your sentiment that pithy is preferred, but I'm not sure there is any room for culling the name as is. yeah, just trying to spark some inspiration, see if anyone has better ideas than `blobbasefeeperblobgas`. Mainly just thinking through my experience of reading different implementations, and seeing the word blob, fee, and gas, blend together with everything else like if I saw `BlobFeePerExcessBlobGasAndPricePerBlobTipCap` somewhere I would not be surprised LOL i think one blob can be removed `basefeeperblobgas` as it provides sufficient context for the unit 😆

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: Do you have a suggestion for a variable name that conveys a similar amount of information in less words?

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: It is not the same as normal gas, so we can't just call it gas lest developers be confused.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: And it is a "fee per gas", not a total fee, so we can't call it "fee" without specifying units, lest developers be confused.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: I agree with your sentiment that pithy is preferred, but I'm not sure there is any room for culling the name as is.
